comments.body: 100% agree - rent makes a huge difference. Look for a room in Juwo/woko flat, keep looking on wgzimmer for a shared flat in the oerlikon area (cheaper rents) - it is possible to get rent under 800. can keep food under 300 if you only buy from the supermarket but realistically good to plan for 400. if you’re an international student, swisscare insurance starts from 70 i think (although most people have the 90 option). If you buy a bike, you dont need to use public transport - many of my friends do this. So it is possible to keep essential expenses under 1350 but a budget of 1500 would give you more wiggle room (it is totally possible to live in zurich under 1500 CHF and eat out and have fun- I’ve been doing that for many years)
